```plato
    // The union of the component bounds. Precondition: at least one component (the
    // declaration allows an empty set, for which there is no bounding rectangle).
    Bounds(s: PolygonSet2D): Bounds2D
        => s.Polygons.Map(p => p.Bounds)
            .Reduce(s.Polygons.First.Bounds, (acc, b) => UnionOfBounds(acc, b));
```
